title: A langur troop's grooming routine

scenes.headline: Today's plan: groom, get groomed, repeat
Part the fur, row by row
scenes.body: Gray langurs are native to India, from forests to towns.

scenes.headline: Rank decides who gets groomed most
scenes.body: Dominant langurs give and receive more grooming than the rest.

scenes.headline: Gray langur groups range from 2 to over 100

caption:
A self-care routine with very strict rules.

Leaves make up roughly half or more of a gray langur's diet, with fruit and flowers on the side.

Source: Animal Diversity Web (Semnopithecus entellus). Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Self-care routine format using one real grooming clip at three moments; the twist (rank decides grooming) makes it educational, not just cute.
